name: Among Us: Impostor
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: Impostor, a private server for Among Us. Players connect through a custom region set to this server's address and port.
startup: ip="{{PUBLIC_IP}}"; if [ -z "$ip" ]; then ip=$(curl -fsS4 --max-time 5 https://api.ipify.org || true); echo "Public address: ${ip:-not found, using 127.0.0.1}"; fi; export IMPOSTOR_Server__PublicIp="${ip:-127.0.0.1}" DOTNET_CLI_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT=1; exec ./Impostor.Server

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Among Us: Impostor. Downloads the Impostor release for the node's CPU from
# GitHub and checks it against GitHub's checksum. config.json and plugins
# are never touched once they exist.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
repo=Impostor/Impostor
case "$(uname -m)" in
x86_64) arch=linux-x64 ;;
aarch64) arch=linux-arm64 ;;
*) echo "Impostor has no build for $(uname -m)."; exit 1 ;;
esac

want="${VERSION:-latest}"
# Impostor's tags start with a v; accept the version either way.
[ "$want" = latest ] || want="v${want#v}"
tag=$(gh-release tag "$repo" "$want") ||
    { echo "Impostor has no release ${VERSION}. Set Version to latest, or to a release such as v1.10.9."; exit 1; }
ver=${tag#v}
asset=$(gh-release assets "$repo" "$tag" | awk -v a="_$arch.tar.gz" '!f && index($1, a) { print $1; f = 1 }')
[ -n "$asset" ] || { echo "Impostor $ver has no download for $arch."; exit 1; }

if [ "$(cat .raptor-impostor 2>/dev/null)" = "$asset" ] && [ -x Impostor.Server ]; then
    echo "Impostor $ver is already installed."
    exit 0
fi

build=/mnt/server/.raptor-build
rm -rf "$build"
mkdir -p "$build/x"
trap 'rm -rf "$build"' EXIT
echo "Downloading Impostor $ver ($arch)"
gh-release download "$repo" "$tag" "$asset" "$build/impostor.tar.gz"
tar -xzf "$build/impostor.tar.gz" -C "$build/x"
[ -f "$build/x/Impostor.Server" ] || { echo "The download has no Impostor.Server in it."; exit 1; }
# The user's settings stay: the release's config.json is only used when
# there is none yet.
if [ -f config.json ]; then rm -f "$build/x/config.json"; fi
cp -a "$build/x/." .
chmod +x Impostor.Server
mkdir -p plugins libraries
echo "$asset" > .raptor-impostor
echo "Installed Impostor $ver."

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The Impostor release to install, such as v1.10.9, or latest.

variables.name: Public address
variables.description: The address players connect to, an IPv4 address or a hostname. Empty finds the server's public IPv4 address at every start.
